output.one_liner: tldraw is a free, instant collaborative whiteboarding tool for teams and creators who need to sketch, plan, and share ideas visually in real time.
output.description: tldraw offers a free, no-signup virtual whiteboard with real-time collaboration. It enables users to draw, annotate, and build visual ideas instantly across devices. The tool emphasizes speed, simplicity, and open extensibility via its SDK.
